title: Inspect and extend: From selected symptoms to an informational score
objective: Use the real implementation in `src/exposure.ts` to demonstrate and safely improve weights, duplicate/unknown filtering, thresholds, advice, and disclaimer.
problem: A score is a simple weighted tally, like adding points on a checklist. Follow each selected symptom to its weight, thresholds, output advice, and UI disclaimer. It is not a clinical model. Your implementation or debugging result must remain consistent with the source architecture.
requirements: Read `src/exposure.ts` and the related project files: src/exposure.ts; src/screens/SymptomsScreen.tsx.
Add or improve a focused behavior related to weights, duplicate/unknown filtering, thresholds, advice, and disclaimer.
Add a meaningful unit test or, when platform tooling is unavailable, document a reproducible manual check.
Update documentation to identify local, simulated, external, and missing behavior accurately.
constraints: Do not claim or implement as complete a capability outside this boundary: The score is educational and is not medical advice or a validated clinical decision tool.
Do not add credentials, personal records, real funds, or unsafe public network exposure.
Keep the change within the existing project architecture and name any new dependencies.
expected_behavior: A score is a simple weighted tally, like adding points on a checklist. Follow each selected symptom to its weight, thresholds, output advice, and UI disclaimer. It is not a clinical model.
acceptance_criteria: The implementation change is traceable to `src/exposure.ts`.
Normal and failure/edge cases are described and tested.
The test outcome and environment are recorded honestly.
README or source comments correctly state remaining limitations.
hints: Read the caller and the closest existing test before editing.
Separate a pure rule test from any UI, device, provider, or network test.
